items.source: Add a highest priority mapping that will associate a specific repository interface with a given CouchbaseOperations.
items.translation: 添加一个最高优先级的映射，将特定的存储库接口与给定的 CouchbaseOperations 关联起来。

items.source: Add a middle priority mapping that will associate any un-mapped repository that deals with the given domain type Class with a given CouchbaseOperations.
items.translation: 添加一个中等优先级的映射，该映射会将处理给定域类型 Class 的任何未映射存储库与具有给定 CouchbaseOperations 关联起来。

items.source: This package contains all classes needed for specific configuration of Spring Data Couchbase.
items.translation: 该包包含用于特定配置 Spring Data Couchbase 所需的所有类。

items.source: This package contains the support classes to configure repositories in the context of Couchbase.
items.translation: 该包包含在 Couchbase 上下文中配置存储库的支持类。

items.source: This package contains the Couchbase implementations to support the Spring Data repository abstraction.
items.translation: 该包包含用于支持 Spring Data 仓库抽象的 Couchbase 实现。

items.source:
In order to customize the mapping between repositories/entity types to couchbase templates, use the provided
mapping's api (eg. in order to have different buckets backing different repositories).
items.translation: 为了自定义存储库/实体类型与 Couchbase 模板之间的映射，请使用提供的映射 API（例如，以便让不同的存储库由不同的 bucket 支持）。

items.source: Change the default couchbase operations in an existing mapping.
items.translation: 修改现有映射中的默认 Couchbase 操作。

items.source: Get the factory instance for the operations.
items.translation: 获取操作所需的工厂实例。
